observation.command: cd /workspace && echo '=== reproduce cgroup threaded-mode constraint (diagnostic) ==='; docker run --rm busybox true 2>&1; echo "no-limits exit: $?"; docker run --rm --memory 1g busybox true 2>&1 | tail -2; echo '=== compose config renders ==='; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.noresources.yml config --quiet && echo "config OK"; echo '=== final e2e: health ==='; curl -sS -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3020/api/health
